backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (Stats, Weapons, Vehicles, Factions, Hazards, etc.) and backend state for the H.E.V HUD application on the Internet Computer. Contains comprehensive type definitions for suit systems, environmental hazards, vehicles, and game modes.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two tracked features: restoring the H.E.V HUD post-boot-sequence rendering, and adding a SKIP button to the boot sequence overlay, with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted reference document summarizing the purpose and key implementation details of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes including colors, borders, charts, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the H.E.V Mark V HUD app with PWA meta tags, manifest link, icons, and the root div that mounts the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA web app manifest for the H.E.V HUD defining app name, icons, display mode, theme color, and orientation settings.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing a cache-first strategy that precaches core assets on install, cleans old caches on activate, and serves cached responses with network fallback for GET requests.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component orchestrating the boot sequence, tab navigation, HUD layout, overlays (CRT, damage, faction switch, emergency mode), and all tab components; includes a DamageIndicatorManager sub-component driven by the suit store.
frontend/src/audio/audioBus.ts: Singleton AudioBus class providing methods to play SFX, voice lines, alert sequences, and layered audio using the Web Audio API with safe fallbacks for autoplay restrictions.
frontend/src/audio/hevVoice.ts: Provides HEV-suit-style voice announcement helpers that play themed audio clips via audioBus for events like module enable/disable, health critical, hazard detection, and stat changes, gated by the voiceEnabled setting.
frontend/src/audio/uiSfx.ts: Provides UI sound effect helpers (tab switch, toggle, button click, confirm, etc.) that play short audio clips via audioBus, gated by the voiceEnabled setting.
frontend/src/components/audio/AmbiencePl: UI component for an ambience audio player with play/pause/skip controls, loop toggle, volume slider, and the ability to add custom audio file tracks from the local filesystem.
frontend/src/components/audio/RadioContr: UI panel for radio communications featuring frequency tuning, signal strength display, channel selection (faction-dependent), and a message transmit interface with broadcast history.
frontend/src/components/boot/BootSequenc: Full-screen animated boot sequence overlay that steps through HEV/faction system initialization stages with a progress bar, logo, glitch effects, and a skip button, calling onComplete when finished.
frontend/src/components/boot/FactionSwit: Full-screen transition overlay displayed when switching factions, showing the target faction's logo, label, and an animated progress bar before calling onComplete after a timed duration.
frontend/src/components/common/HudDivide: Simple HUD divider component that renders a styled horizontal rule, with an optional decorative variant that adds corner accents.
frontend/src/components/common/HudSectio: HUD section wrapper component with an optional titled header and collapsible toggle behavior for grouping related UI content.
frontend/src/components/common/HudSwitch: Thin wrapper around the shadcn Switch component that applies a HUD-specific CSS class.
frontend/src/components/common/HudToolti: Wrapper around shadcn Tooltip components providing a simple HUD-styled tooltip with configurable side and delay.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React class-based error boundary that catches runtime errors and displays a styled 'SYSTEM ERROR' fallback UI with an error message and a reload button.
frontend/src/components/hazards/Environm: Renders a tactical panel listing five environmental hazards (fire, bio, radiation, electrical, gas) with progress bars and status labels derived from the hazards store.
frontend/src/components/hazards/GeigerCo: Displays an animated Geiger counter HUD panel showing radiation level with a smoothly interpolated value, ticking effect, and color-coded critical/warning states.
frontend/src/components/hazards/HazardWa: Shows a fixed overlay of hazard warning icons for any hazard type exceeding 75%, with optional pulse animation and reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/components/hazards/Horizont: Renders a horizontal grid panel of five environmental hazards with icons, progress bars, and severity-based CSS classes sourced from the hazards store.
frontend/src/components/hev/Contaminatio: Static HEV suit panel displaying contamination exposure levels, decontamination status, airborne hazard analysis, and suit breach warnings using hardcoded values.
frontend/src/components/hev/Environmenta: Static HEV suit panel showing respirator, hazmat seal, temperature regulation, and atmospheric composition data with hardcoded nominal values.
frontend/src/components/hev/RadiationAna: HEV radiation analysis panel that reads live radiation level from the hazards store and displays dosimeter readings, isotope identification, shielding effectiveness, and safe exposure time.
frontend/src/components/hud/CriticalStat: Wrapper component that applies a pulsing colored border around its children when a critical stat threshold is active, with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/components/hud/CrtOverlay.t: Fixed full-screen overlay that applies CRT visual effects including a texture, scanlines, vignette, and optional flicker animation with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/components/hud/DamageIndica: Renders a directional red gradient flash overlay on screen edges when the player takes damage, auto-dismissing after 800ms (or 300ms for reduced motion).
frontend/src/components/hud/EmergencyMod: Full-screen emergency mode HUD view showing critical vitals, hazard status, and quick-toggle controls for pain suppression and auto-stimulant, with a button to exit emergency mode.
frontend/src/components/hud/EnhancedStat: Displays a row of tooltip-enabled badge indicators for active status conditions such as shield boost, hazard detection, low ammo, critical health, and radio offline.
frontend/src/components/hud/FactionLayou: Wraps children in a div with a CSS class determined by the current faction/system style (HEV, HECU, guard, or resistance) for faction-specific layout styling.
frontend/src/components/hud/HudGlobalEff: Renders non-interactive full-screen overlay effects including bloom, critical flash, presence glow, and HL1-style scanlines, respecting reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/hud/HudLayout.ts: Top-level HUD layout shell that applies faction CSS class, UI scale, opacity, a header bar with logo and clock, and wraps page content in a main element.
frontend/src/components/hud/HudOfflineOv: Simple overlay displayed when the HUD system is disabled, showing a warning icon and instructions to re-enable it via the INFO tab.
frontend/src/components/hud/HudTabsBar.t: Renders the navigation tab bar with faction-specific extra tabs, alert dot indicators for critical stats/hazards, and plays a sound effect on tab switch.
frontend/src/components/hud/LowAmmoWarni: Small inline warning component that shows a pulsing yellow alert triangle and 'LOW' label when ammunition is below threshold.
frontend/src/components/hud/MarkIGlitchO: Conditionally renders Mark I HEV glitch visual effects (flicker, scanline sweep, color shift) driven by the useMarkGlitchEffects hook.
frontend/src/components/hud/MinimalHudVi: Compact HUD view showing only core stats (health, armor, ammo, aux) with progress bars, critical warnings, an optional hazard panel, and a button to restore standard display mode.
frontend/src/components/hud/Panels.tsx: Defines reusable HUD panel components (StatPanel, MeterPanel, VitalsPanel) that display animated stat values with color-coded progress bars reflecting critical/warning states.
frontend/src/components/hud/SuitVoiceRea: Displays a rotating suit voice message ticker that shows style-specific status messages or critical warnings based on health, armor, and hazard levels.
frontend/src/components/hud/TacticalHudS: Wraps HUD content in a tactical layout with top bar, left/right sidebars showing combat stats, and a center reticle overlay; only renders for suit marks that support tactical mode.
frontend/src/components/hud/TacticalOver: Renders a purely decorative tactical overlay with corner frames, a center reticle, and fixed readout labels for threat level, combat mode, targeting, comms, and other system statuses.
frontend/src/components/info/CharacterBa: Displays a collapsible operator profile panel showing biography, role, achievements, and context for the selected character based on the operator name from settings.
frontend/src/components/info/CommandCons: Provides an interactive command console with input history navigation, command execution via executeCommand, and scrollable output of past commands and responses.
frontend/src/components/info/ConfirmActi: A reusable confirmation dialog built on AlertDialog that plays UI sound effects on confirm or cancel and exposes confirm/cancel callbacks.
frontend/src/components/info/DataVisuali: Provides three reusable data visualization components: a Sparkline (SVG polyline chart), a RadialGauge (circular SVG progress indicator), and a BarChart (labeled progress-bar list).
frontend/src/components/info/EquipmentDe: Renders a collapsible panel listing H.E.V. equipment modules from equipmentData, showing specifications, capabilities, and operational notes for each module.
frontend/src/components/info/OperatorPro: Displays an operator profile HUD panel with dynamic designation, clearance level, suit serial, biometric ID, and a live mission timer that updates every second based on infoSettingsStore.
frontend/src/components/info/SuitLorePan: Renders a collapsible panel displaying H.E.V. suit lore and history sections sourced from suitLoreData, with expand/collapse toggle per section.
frontend/src/components/info/SuitSubsyst: Displays interactive H.E.V. suit subsystem status rows (life support, environmental protection, power, radio, HUD) with toggles that trigger confirmation modals, log entries, sound effects, and voice feedback.
frontend/src/components/info/SystemDiagn: Shows a diagnostics panel with computed metrics (module load, power consumption, system health, network status) derived from suit state, hazards, and settings stores, with style-aware title.
frontend/src/components/info/SystemLogVi: Renders a scrollable list of system log entries from the log store, displaying timestamp, type, and message for each entry.
frontend/src/components/medical/MedicalD: Displays an H.E.V. suit schematic image overlaid with color-coded status indicators for head, torso, and arms based on health and armor values.
frontend/src/components/medical/MedicalI: Renders interactive medical HUD panels including limb integrity, emergency SOS, neural interface status, and advanced medical system toggles (pain suppression, auto-stimulant, nano-repair, bio-monitor) with sound effects and system log entries.
frontend/src/components/medical/MedicalR: Displays read-only medical data panels (vital signs, trauma assessment) with health-derived values like heart rate, blood pressure, respiration, toxin levels, and pain index pulled from suit and hazard state stores.
frontend/src/components/medical/Morphine: A HUD module for administering a morphine dose with a 60-second cooldown timer, showing a depleting dose bar and a button that is disabled during cooldown.
frontend/src/components/medical/OxygenLe: A HUD module displaying animated O₂ saturation with simulated depletion and refill cycles, showing critical/warning color states and a toggle button to start or stop depletion.
frontend/src/components/medical/panels/E: A HUD panel managing an emergency SOS beacon with arm/disarm toggle, signal spoofing ("polite panic mode") switch, and a test burst button that cycles through STANDBY, ARMED, and TRANSMITTING states.
frontend/src/components/medical/panels/L: A HUD panel displaying integrity, servo load, and fracture probability for each limb (arms and legs), with per-limb calibration toggles that log state changes.
frontend/src/components/military/Advance: Renders a military tactical UI panel displaying threat assessment, fire support status, engagement protocols (ROE, OPORD), and tactical overlay data (grid reference, elevation, bearing).
frontend/src/components/military/Expande: Displays a weapons specifications panel listing stats (damage, range, penetration, ammo type, readiness) for three predefined weapons with progress bars.
frontend/src/components/military/SquadSt: Shows a squad status panel for four hardcoded team members, displaying health, armor progress bars, role, position, and active/wounded/KIA status badges.
frontend/src/components/security/AccessC: Provides a facility access control UI with toggleable lockdown mode, door lock/unlock status display, and a security clearance level progress indicator.
frontend/src/components/security/Facilit: Renders an interactive facility map with zoom controls, clickable sector markers, and animated vent access point indicators overlaid on a static map image.
frontend/src/components/security/Securit: Displays a grid of security camera feeds with selectable/cyclable cameras, showing status indicators, location labels, and live timestamps.
frontend/src/components/settings/HevMark: A settings UI component for selecting the H.E.V. suit mark/version, allowing users to choose a visual style and optionally decouple it from the functional profile using a toggle switch and radio group.
frontend/src/components/tactical/Mission: Displays a HUD panel showing mission objectives with status/priority badges and a list of waypoints, with title text that adapts based on the current system style.
frontend/src/components/tactical/QuickAc: Renders a grid of toggle buttons for quickly enabling or disabling suit modules (flashlight, helmet, respirator, etc.), wiring each button to the toggleModule mutation with UI sound effects.
frontend/src/components/tactical/RadarPa: A canvas-based animated radar display that renders a rotating sweep line, concentric range rings, and pulsing contact blips color-coded by type (friendly, hostile, unknown), with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/components/tactical/ThreatA: Calculates and displays an overall threat index derived from hazard levels, health, and armor, showing a filled meter bar, per-category breakdowns, and a contextual recommendation message.
frontend/src/components/tactical/UnitTra: Shows a two-cell HUD panel with simulated hostile and friendly unit counts derived from the current threat level, with animated warning styling when hostiles are present.
frontend/src/components/utilities/Flashl: A HUD panel component that displays flashlight battery level, depleting when active and recharging when off, with animated power bar and color-coded status warnings.
frontend/src/components/utilities/Gravit: A HUD panel that queries and controls a gravity gun device via actor mutations, displaying active status, mode, charge level, and a supercharge button.
frontend/src/components/utilities/MiniAu: A fixed-position mini audio player UI with play/pause, skip, mute, and volume slider controls, supporting a minimized floating button state.
frontend/src/components/vehicles/Vehicle: A HUD panel displaying vehicle stats (fuel, integrity, speed) with progress bars and optional detailed engine specs and tactical capabilities sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAutoUiScale.ts: A hook that calculates and reactively updates a UI scale factor based on viewport width, interpolating between min and max scale for small screens.
A hook that animates a numeric display value from its previous to its target value using an ease-out interpolation, respecting reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/useHudPresence.ts: A hook that tracks pointer and touch position on a container element and updates CSS custom properties (--pointer-x, --pointer-y, --pointer-intensity) via rAF-throttled updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication via DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarkFeatures.ts: Returns the active MarkFeatureSet based on the current HEV mark settings, respecting the separation of mark style from function.
Generates randomized glitch visual effects (flickering, text corruption, color shift, etc.) on an interval, applied only for Mark I and when reduced motion is not preferred.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating HEV suit data (stats, modules, gravity gun, vehicles) via the canister actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useReducedMotion.ts: Detects and reactively tracks the user's `prefers-reduced-motion` media query preference, returning a boolean.
frontend/src/hooks/useSystemMetrics.ts: Computes derived HUD system metrics (system health, power efficiency, module load, network connectivity, overall status) from suit and hazard state.
frontend/src/hooks/useViewportOrientatio: Detects and reactively tracks whether the viewport is in landscape orientation using matchMedia and resize/orientationchange events.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining the OKLCH-based HEV HUD color system, Tailwind imports, faction theme variants, global resets, and HUD container styles.
frontend/src/lib/characterBackstories.ts: Defines backstory data (biography, role, achievements, context) for Half-Life characters and exports a lookup function by name.
frontend/src/lib/commands.ts: Defines an `executeCommand` function that parses slash commands (e.g., /health, /armor, /hazard) and dispatches updates to the suit, hazards, and log Zustand stores.
frontend/src/lib/equipmentData.ts: Exports a typed array of H.E.V. equipment module descriptors, each containing name, category, specifications, capabilities, and operational notes.
frontend/src/lib/glyphs.ts: Exports a `GLYPHS` constant mapping semantic names (fire, bio, radiation, etc.) to monochrome Unicode symbols for use in the HUD.
frontend/src/lib/markFeatureSets.ts: Defines per-Mark feature availability records (stats, panels, tabs, modules, advanced features) for each H.E.V. suit version from Mark I onward.
frontend/src/lib/markThemes.ts: Defines color palettes and visual characteristics for each H.E.V. Mark variant, with a `getMarkTheme` helper that falls back to Mark V.
frontend/src/lib/suitLoreData.ts: Exports an array of lore sections with titles and narrative content covering the H.E.V. suit's development history, specifications, and in-universe context.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry point that mounts the app wrapped in `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Registers a service worker at `/service-worker.js` on page load if the browser supports it.
frontend/src/state/audioState.ts: Zustand store managing an audio playlist with play/pause/stop/next/previous controls, volume, loop toggle, and custom track upload via object URLs.
frontend/src/state/hazardAlerts.ts: Zustand store and React hook that polls hazard levels every second, triggers critical flashing state when any hazard exceeds 80%, and fires a throttled HEV voice alert on transition to critical.
frontend/src/state/hazardsState.ts: Zustand store tracking per-hazard environmental levels (fire, bio, radiation, electrical, gas) with setters, aggregate calculation, and status label helper.
frontend/src/state/infoSettingsStore.ts: Persisted Zustand store managing all HUD/UI settings including system style, display mode, HEV mark, voice/AI toggles, operator name, and faction switching, with computed theme properties and corresponding action methods.
frontend/src/state/suitState.ts: Zustand store for HEV suit stats (health, armor, aux, ammo, hazard), module toggles, and damage direction events, including threshold checks and clamped setters.
frontend/src/state/systemLog.ts: Zustand store maintaining a capped 100-entry system log with typed entries (system, warning, hazard, etc.) and add/clear actions.
frontend/src/state/tacticalState.ts: Zustand store for tactical HUD data including threat level, mission status, objectives with priorities, waypoints, and engagement status.
frontend/src/state/uiState.ts: Minimal Zustand store managing a single landscape mode toggle for UI layout.
frontend/src/state/weaponSystemsState.ts: Zustand store tracking the currently selected weapon, ammo type, and fire rate with simple setters and a reset action.
frontend/src/tabs/ArsenalTab.tsx: React tab component that displays a faction-specific weapon list with selectable entries and renders detailed stats (damage, accuracy, fire rate, etc.) for the selected weapon using progress bars and badges.
frontend/src/tabs/BasicsTab.tsx: React tab component rendering core HEV suit stats (health, armor, aux, ammo) as stat panels with conditional warning banners, plus hazard and Geiger counter modules.
frontend/src/tabs/CommandBriefingTab.tsx: Renders a static HECU military command briefing UI showing chain of command, prioritized operation orders (containment, witness elimination, asset recovery), and rules of engagement with styled badges and panels.
Displays a Black Mesa facility security dashboard with sector status grid, live surveillance camera feeds, and access control door statuses using static data.
frontend/src/tabs/HazardsTab.tsx: Shows environmental hazard monitoring (fire, bio, radiation, electrical, gas) with collapsible detail panels, aggregate hazard level, and protection system status; gated behind Mark II+ feature flags and styled per system role.
frontend/src/tabs/HevTab.tsx: Renders the H.E.V. suit hazard systems tab, composing ContaminationMonitorPanel, RadiationAnalysisPanel, and EnvironmentalProtectionPanel into labeled tactical panels.
frontend/src/tabs/InfoTab.tsx: Composes the Info tab from multiple sub-panels including operator profile, character backstory, suit subsystems, equipment descriptions, lore, system log, and command console, with subsystem title varying by system style.
frontend/src/tabs/MainTab.tsx: Displays the primary HUD overview with health, armor, aux power, and ammo stats as progress bars, plus an environmental hazards summary grid, with color-coded status indicators.
frontend/src/tabs/MedicalTab.tsx: Renders the medical tab by composing MedicalReadouts, MorphineDoseModule, OxygenLevelModule, and MedicalInteractivePanels into a simple grid layout.
frontend/src/tabs/MilitaryTab.tsx: Renders the Military Operations tab composing AdvancedTacticalPanel, ExpandedWeaponsPanel, and SquadStatusPanel into labeled tactical panels.
frontend/src/tabs/ObjectivesTab.tsx: Displays faction-specific mission objectives (HEV, HECU, Security) with priority badges, status toggles, location info, and rewards. Objectives are stored in local state and can be toggled between active and completed.
frontend/src/tabs/ResearchLabTab.tsx: Renders a Black Mesa research database UI with accordion sections for experiment logs, anomalous materials data, and teleportation technology details.
frontend/src/tabs/SecurityTab.tsx: Composes the Security Operations tab by rendering the facility map, surveillance camera grid, and access control panels as distinct sections.
frontend/src/tabs/SettingsTab.tsx: Provides a comprehensive settings UI for configuring voice, HUD opacity, UI scale, display mode, faction/system style, operator name, and other toggles, with options to reset all settings and install the app as a PWA.
Shows real-time suit diagnostics including power consumption, battery charge, time remaining, module status, and system health calculated from suit store state.
frontend/src/tabs/TacticalTab.tsx: Renders the Tactical tab layout combining radar, unit tracker, threat assessment, and mission briefing panels in a responsive grid.
frontend/src/tabs/UtilitiesTab.tsx: Provides equipment module toggles, flashlight power control, gravity gun control (HL2 mode), ambience player, and radio control panel, with audio feedback and log entries on module state changes.
frontend/src/tabs/VehiclesTab.tsx: Fetches and displays vehicle status panels from a query hook, showing a loading spinner or error message as appropriate, with optional detailed mode.
frontend/src/tabs/WeaponsTab.tsx: React tab component displaying the full Half-Life 1 weapons arsenal with stats (damage, fire rate, accuracy, etc.), lore, technical specs, and collapsible detail sections. Uses Zustand for settings state and shadcn/ui components for layout.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts (Orbitron, Share Tech Mono), minimal border radii, faction-specific color tokens (hev, hecu, security, resistance), glow box shadows, and HUD-themed animations.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking the H.E.V HUD app's known issues (HUD disappearing post-boot), existing features, and two pending action requests: restoring the HUD after boot sequence and adding a skip button to the boot overlay.
